summary: Plan farm-compatible solar projects with practical site, economics and monitoring tools. Explore the agrivoltaics training course.
lede: Agrivoltaics planning combines photovoltaic generation with continued agricultural use and requires decisions about site suitability, layouts and project economics. For agribusiness and renewable-energy project managers, extension leaders, utility planners and public-sector officials, the course covers QGIS and solar-resource screening, crop-and-PV layout choices, Excel cash-flow assessment, stakeholder responsibilities, and agricultural and energy performance measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, plan, coordinate or oversee solar generation projects that share land with agricultural production.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with agricultural operations, renewable-energy projects or project planning is recommended. No programming is required; the course uses concept-level screening and financial analysis rather than detailed PV engineering or crop-specific research.
